title: The Pacifist Mercenary
logline: A retired war hero who took a vow of non-violence hires a pilot to peacefully secure their old armory before their hot-headed protege can use it to start a new gang war.

roles.description: Serene, completely committed to peace, but still terrifyingly competent.
Young, angry, desperate to prove themselves.
An asteroid bunker packed with illegal military hardware.
A ragtag group of aspiring rebels looking for weapons.

public_situation: The {role:local_militia} is openly recruiting for a violent uprising, promising they have secured heavy weapons.
private_truth: The weapons belong to the pacifist hero. The protege stole the coordinates but cannot bypass the armory's security grid.

beats.public_change: The protege's ship begins aggressively patrolling the sector near the armory.

missions.reason: The hero hires the pilot to fly to the armory and collect the main power core to render the weapons useless.
missions.private_fact: The hero insists the pilot must not harm the protege under any circumstances.

beats.public_change: The protege realizes the armory is disabled and calls in the militia fleet.

missions.reason: The protege demands the pilot scan their ship's nav computer to prove the hero gave them the wrong armory coordinates.
missions.private_fact: The scan reveals the protege is actually just stalling while they hack the armory's manual override.

beats.public_change: The armory's doors begin to open on manual override.

missions.reason: The hero pays the pilot to disable the protege's ship without killing them.
missions.private_fact: The protege hails the pilot, offering them the pick of the armory if they help destroy the hero's pacifist compound instead.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot disables the protege's ship.
resolutions.summary: The armory is secured. The hero forgives the protege, and the militia's rebellion fizzles out without weapons.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot stopped a gang of kids from getting their hands on enough guns to start a war.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the protege's offer.
resolutions.summary: The protege secures the weapons and arms the militia. The hero is forced to flee, and the sector burns.
The militia overwhelms the armory's defenses. They take the weapons, and the hero is forced into exile.

loose_threads.detail: The militia's recruitment funds were traced back to a series of anonymous donations from an off-world charity.
The armory's manifest shows that a shipment of heavy weapons was quietly removed two days before the hero locked it down.

radio_hooks: {role:local_militia} openly recruiting; promises "a new dawn" is coming.

voice_direction.pacifist_hero: Calm, centering, speaks softly but clearly.
voice_direction.hotheaded_protege: Loud, abrasive, overcompensating for their lack of experience.
